# Flowly Customer Support Policy

*Owner: Customer Experience team. Effective April 1, 2026.*

This policy describes how Flowly (a fictional Tel Aviv SaaS company) supports its customers: support hours, response times, refunds, and escalations. It applies to all support agents and Customer Success Managers (CSMs).

## 1. Support Channels

| Plan | Channels |
|---|---|
| Free | Help Center, community forum, email (support@flowly.io) |
| Pro | Email and in-app chat |
| Enterprise | Email, in-app chat, phone, dedicated CSM, shared Slack channel (for customers above 200 seats) |

All tickets are managed in **Zendesk**. Every ticket gets a priority set by the agent.

## 2. Support Hours

- **Standard support**: Sunday to Thursday, **08:00 to 20:00** Israel time, and Monday to Friday **09:00 to 18:00 US Eastern time** through our New York-based team.
- **Friday (Israel)**: reduced shift from **09:00 to 13:00**.
- **Enterprise P1 (critical) incidents**: **24/7**, including weekends and holidays, through the on-call engineer.
- Support is closed on Israeli public holidays listed in the Employee Handbook, except for Enterprise P1 incidents and the US team.

## 3. Priority Levels

- **P1 (Critical)**: Flowly is down or unusable for the whole account, or there is a suspected data loss or security issue.
- **P2 (High)**: a major feature (for example, automations or integrations) does not work, and there is no workaround.
- **P3 (Normal)**: a feature works partially, or there is a workaround.
- **P4 (Low)**: questions, how-to requests, and feature requests.

## 4. SLA: First Response Times

First response time is measured during support hours, except for Enterprise P1, which is measured 24/7.

| Priority | Free | Pro | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1 Critical | 24 hours | **4 hours** | **1 hour** (24/7) |
| P2 High | 48 hours | **8 hours** | **2 hours** |
| P3 Normal | 3 business days | **1 business day** | **4 hours** |
| P4 Low | Best effort | 2 business days | 1 business day |

**Resolution targets** (not guaranteed): P1 within 8 hours for Enterprise, P2 within 2 business days.

Our team target is that **95%** of tickets meet the first-response SLA each month, and that customer satisfaction (CSAT) stays above **92%**.

## 5. Uptime SLA and Service Credits

Enterprise customers are guaranteed **99.9% monthly uptime**, excluding scheduled maintenance (announced at least **72 hours** in advance on status.flowly.io and done on Saturdays between 02:00 and 06:00 Israel time).

If uptime falls below the SLA, Enterprise customers can request service credits:

| Monthly uptime | Credit (of monthly fee) |
|---|---|
| 99.0% to 99.9% | 10% |
| 95.0% to 99.0% | 25% |
| Below 95.0% | 50% |

Credits must be requested within **30 days** of the end of the affected month. Pro and Free plans have no uptime SLA.

## 6. Refund Policy

- **Annual plans**: full refund if requested within **30 days** of the initial purchase or renewal. After 30 days, no refund; the plan stays active until the end of the term.
- **Monthly plans**: no refunds. Customers can cancel at any time, and the cancellation takes effect at the end of the current month.
- **Removed users**: unused time is applied as a credit to the next invoice, not refunded in cash.
- **Billing errors** (for example, double charges): always refunded in full, within **5 business days**.
- **Approval limits**: support agents may approve refunds up to **$500**. Refunds from $500 to $5,000 require the Support Team Lead. Refunds above **$5,000** require the VP Customer Experience.
- Refunds are returned to the original payment method and usually appear within 5 to 10 business days.

## 7. Escalation Process

1. **Tier 1 (Support Agent)**: handles all incoming tickets, how-to questions, and billing questions.
2. **Tier 2 (Senior Support / Technical Support)**: a Tier 1 agent escalates if the issue is not solved within **2 hours** of work, or requires logs, data fixes, or API debugging.
3. **Tier 3 (R&D on-call engineer)**: Tier 2 escalates confirmed bugs and all P1 incidents. Engineering opens a Jira ticket linked to the Zendesk ticket.
4. **Management escalation**: if an Enterprise customer is at risk of churn, or a P1 lasts more than **4 hours**, the Support Team Lead notifies the **VP Customer Experience, Lior Avrahami** (fictional), and the customer's CSM.

For every P1 incident, Flowly publishes updates on status.flowly.io at least **every 30 minutes**, and sends a written **post-incident report within 5 business days** to affected Enterprise customers.

Security-related issues (for example, a suspected account takeover) are escalated immediately to security@flowly.io, as described in the Security & IT Policy.

## 8. What Support Does Not Cover

- Building custom automations or boards for customers (available as paid Professional Services at **$180 per hour**, Enterprise only).
- Problems with third-party tools not caused by Flowly.
- Custom code written by the customer using the Flowly API.

## 9. Customer Communication Standards

- Reply in the customer's language when possible (English, Hebrew, Spanish, and German are supported).
- Close a ticket only after the customer confirms, or after **3 days** with no reply following a solution.
- Every closed ticket triggers a one-question CSAT survey.

# Flowly Ltd. Employee Handbook

*Version 4.2, effective January 1, 2026. Owner: People & Culture team (people@flowly.io).*

Flowly Ltd. is a fictional B2B SaaS company headquartered at 22 Rothschild Boulevard, Tel Aviv. We build Flowly, a workflow and project-management platform for teams. As of 2026 we have about 80 employees across R&D, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and G&A. This handbook explains the policies that apply to all full-time employees in Israel. Contractors should refer to their contract.

## 1. Working Hours

- The standard work week is **Sunday to Thursday**, 42 hours per week.
- **Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00** (Israel time). Everyone is expected to be available for meetings during core hours, except on approved leave.
- Outside core hours, employees may arrange their schedule flexibly with their manager.
- Friday is not a working day. Customer Support runs a reduced Friday shift (see the Customer Support Policy).
- Overtime is paid according to Israeli law for hourly roles. Global-salary roles include overtime in the monthly salary.
- Hours are reported in **Hibob** by the 3rd business day of the following month.

## 2. Remote Work Policy (Hybrid)

- Flowly is a hybrid company. Employees work from the office **at least 3 days per week**.
- **Tuesday is "Team Day"**: all employees are expected in the office. The all-hands meeting is held on the first Tuesday of every month at 12:00.
- Employees may work fully remote for up to **2 consecutive weeks per calendar year** (for example, from abroad), with manager approval submitted at least 14 days in advance.
- Work from abroad longer than 2 weeks requires approval from the VP People and the CFO for tax reasons.
- Remote work must be done from a private, secure network. Public Wi-Fi requires the company VPN (see the Security & IT Policy).
- Each employee receives a one-time **home office stipend of ₪1,500** after completing 3 months of employment.

## 3. Vacation Days

- Full-time employees receive **18 vacation days per year** in their first 3 years.
- From the start of year 4, employees receive **21 days per year**.
- From year 7 onward, employees receive **24 days per year**.
- Vacation accrues monthly (1.5 days per month for the 18-day tier).
- Up to **10 unused days** may be carried over to the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by **March 31**, or they expire.
- Vacation requests of 3 days or more must be submitted in Hibob at least **2 weeks in advance**.
- Flowly closes for a company-wide shutdown between **Rosh Hashanah and Sukkot** on 2 working days per year, which are deducted from vacation balance and announced in January.

## 4. Sick Days

- Employees receive **18 sick days per year** (1.5 per month), in line with Israeli law, accumulating up to a maximum of 90 days.
- Flowly pays **100% of salary from the first sick day**, which is more generous than the legal minimum.
- A doctor's note is required for absences of **3 consecutive days or more**.
- Up to **6 of the yearly sick days** may be used to care for a sick child, partner, or parent.
- Notify your manager and update Hibob by 10:00 on the day of absence.

## 5. Public Holidays

Flowly observes Israeli public holidays. The office is closed and the day is fully paid on:

- Rosh Hashanah (2 days) and the eve of Rosh Hashanah
- Yom Kippur and the eve of Yom Kippur
- Sukkot (first day) and Simchat Torah
- Passover (first and seventh days) and the eve of Passover
- Independence Day (Yom Ha'atzmaut)
- Shavuot

Employees may also take **1 "choice day"** per year for a personal or religious holiday of their choice (for example, Christmas, Eid al-Fitr, or Novruz), in addition to vacation days. Election days are paid days off.

## 6. Equipment

- Every new employee receives a laptop on their first day:
  - **R&D and Data**: MacBook Pro 14" (M-series, 32 GB RAM).
  - **All other roles**: MacBook Air 13" (16 GB RAM).
- Each employee also receives a 27" monitor for home use, a keyboard, a mouse, and noise-cancelling headphones.
- Laptops are replaced every **3 years**, or earlier if broken through no fault of the employee.
- All equipment remains Flowly property and must be returned within **5 business days** of the last working day.
- Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to IT within **24 hours** (see the Security & IT Policy).

## 7. Expenses and Reimbursement

All expenses are submitted in **Expensify** with a receipt within **30 days** of purchase. Expenses older than 60 days will not be reimbursed. Reimbursements are paid with the next monthly salary.

| Category | Limit |
|---|---|
| Learning budget (courses, books, conferences) | ₪4,000 per year |
| Client meals | ₪150 per person per meal |
| Team meals during overtime (after 20:00) | ₪80 per person |
| Taxi | Only between 22:00 and 06:00, or with manager approval |
| Home internet | ₪100 per month |
| Mobile phone | Up to ₪120 per month |
| Wellness (gym, yoga, sports) | ₪250 per month |

- Any single expense above **₪1,000** requires written manager approval **before** purchase.
- Business travel abroad is booked through the Operations team (ops@flowly.io). The daily allowance abroad is **$75 per day** for meals.
- Alcohol is not reimbursed except at approved team events.

## 8. Benefits

- Keren Hishtalmut (study fund) contributions of 7.5% employer / 2.5% employee for all employees from day one.
- Pension according to Israeli law, with employer contribution of 6.5% plus 6% severance.
- Monthly **Cibus meal card of ₪1,100**.
- Private health insurance for employees and family members.
- Birthday day off (to be taken in the same month as the birthday).

## 9. Conduct and Questions

All employees must follow the Code of Conduct and the Security & IT Policy. For questions about this handbook, contact the People & Culture team at people@flowly.io or **Maya Levin-Shahar, VP People** (fictional).

# Flowly New Employee Onboarding Guide

*Owner: People & Culture. Last updated: February 2026.*

Welcome to Flowly! This guide explains what happens in your first week and your first 90 days. Flowly is a fictional Tel Aviv SaaS company of about 80 people building a workflow and project-management platform. Your onboarding is managed in Flowly itself, on the board called **"Onboarding: [your name]"**, which your manager creates before you arrive.

## Before Day 1

- You will sign your contract and receive a welcome email from people@flowly.io.
- New employees always start on a **Sunday**. Arrive at **09:30** at 22 Rothschild Boulevard, Tel Aviv, 7th floor.
- Bring a government ID and your bank details for payroll.
- Your laptop is prepared by IT and waiting at reception.
- You will be assigned an **Onboarding Buddy**: a colleague from another team who answers informal questions during your first 30 days. Lunch with your buddy on Day 1 is paid by Flowly.

## First Week Schedule

### Day 1 (Sunday)
- 09:30 Welcome and coffee with People & Culture.
- 10:00 Laptop setup with IT. You will enroll your device in **Kandji** (device management) and set up **1Password** and 2FA.
- 11:30 Office tour and security badge.
- 12:30 Lunch with your Onboarding Buddy.
- 14:00 Meeting with your manager: role expectations and the 30/60/90 plan.
- 15:30 Complete HR forms in **Hibob**.

### Day 2 (Monday)
- 10:00 "Flowly 101" product demo with the Product team (90 minutes).
- 13:00 Mandatory **security awareness training** (60 minutes). Must be completed within your first week.
- Afternoon: team introductions and reading documentation in **Notion**.

### Day 3 (Tuesday, Team Day)
- Everyone is in the office. Join your team's weekly planning.
- 16:00 Coffee with the CEO, **Daniel Ofer** (fictional). New hires meet the CEO in small groups.

### Day 4 (Wednesday)
- Customer immersion: listen to **2 recorded customer calls** in Gong and shadow a Customer Support shift for 1 hour.
- Read the Product FAQ and Customer Support Policy.

### Day 5 (Thursday)
- First small task assigned by your manager (for R&D, a "first commit" to production by the end of week 2).
- 15:00 End-of-week check-in with your manager.

## Tools and Access

All accounts use Single Sign-On (SSO) through **Okta**. Access is requested in the **#it-help** Slack channel or at it@flowly.io.

| Tool | Purpose | Who gets it |
|---|---|---|
| Okta | SSO for all tools | Everyone |
| Google Workspace | Email, calendar, Drive | Everyone |
| Slack | Internal communication | Everyone |
| Flowly (internal workspace) | Tasks and projects | Everyone |
| Notion | Documentation and wiki | Everyone |
| 1Password | Password manager | Everyone |
| Hibob | HR, vacation, hours | Everyone |
| Expensify | Expenses | Everyone |
| GitHub | Source code | R&D |
| AWS (read-only at first) | Infrastructure | R&D, after 2 weeks |
| Salesforce | CRM | Sales, Customer Success |
| Zendesk | Support tickets | Support, Customer Success |
| Gong | Call recordings | Sales, CS, Product |

Production access for engineers is granted only after **2 weeks** and approval by the team lead and the Security team.

## Who to Contact

| Topic | Contact |
|---|---|
| HR, payroll, vacation | people@flowly.io / Maya Levin-Shahar, VP People |
| Laptop, accounts, access | #it-help on Slack / it@flowly.io / Tom Biran, IT Manager |
| Security concerns or incidents | security@flowly.io / #security-incidents |
| Office, travel, equipment | ops@flowly.io / Noa Kedem, Office & Operations Manager |
| Expenses and reimbursement | finance@flowly.io |
| Product questions | #ask-product on Slack |

(All names are fictional.)

## 30/60/90 Day Goals

Your manager will customize these goals, but every new employee follows this structure.

### First 30 days: Learn
- Complete all mandatory training (security awareness, Code of Conduct, product demo).
- Meet at least **10 colleagues** in 1:1 coffees, including someone from Sales, R&D, and Support.
- Understand Flowly's 3 plans (Free, Pro, Enterprise) and its top customers.
- Deliver your first small task.
- **Day 30 review** with your manager and buddy.

### First 60 days: Contribute
- Own at least **one project or recurring responsibility** end to end.
- Present a short "fresh eyes" document: 3 things you would improve at Flowly.
- Work independently on routine tasks.
- **Day 60 check-in** with your manager.

### First 90 days: Own
- Deliver measurable results on your role's key metrics (for example, closing your first deal, shipping a feature, or resolving 150 support tickets).
- Lead a meeting or a demo for your team.
- Agree on goals for the next 6 months.
- **Day 90 review**: the formal end of the probation period. Probation for all roles is **3 months**.

## Tips

- Ask questions in public Slack channels so others benefit from the answers.
- Use your ₪4,000 yearly learning budget (see the Employee Handbook).
- Your home office stipend of ₪1,500 becomes available after 3 months.

# Flowly Product FAQ

*For customers and internal teams. Last updated: March 2026. Prices in US dollars, excluding VAT.*

Flowly is a fictional B2B workflow and project-management platform. Teams use Flowly to plan projects, track tasks on boards, automate repetitive work, and report on progress. Flowly was founded in 2019 in Tel Aviv and serves about **3,200 paying customers** in 40 countries.

## Plans and Prices

| | Free | Pro | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|
| Price (annual billing) | $0 | **$12** per user/month | Custom (starting at **$24** per user/month) |
| Price (monthly billing) | $0 | **$15** per user/month | Annual contracts only |
| Users | Up to **3** | 3 to 500 | Unlimited (minimum **50 seats**) |
| Boards | Up to **5** | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Storage | **2 GB** total | **100 GB** per account | **1 TB** per account (expandable) |
| Automations | **100** runs/month | **10,000** runs/month | **250,000** runs/month |
| File upload size | 50 MB | 500 MB | 2 GB |
| Activity history | 7 days | 1 year | Unlimited |
| Support | Community and email | Email and chat | Priority, phone, dedicated CSM |

## Features per Plan

**Free** includes: boards, tasks, Kanban and list views, comments, mobile apps, and basic integrations (Slack and Google Drive).

**Pro** includes everything in Free, plus:
- Gantt (timeline) and calendar views
- Dashboards with up to **10 widgets** each
- Automations (10,000 runs/month)
- Time tracking
- Guest access (guests are free, up to **5 guests per paid user**)
- **Flowly AI** assistant: task summaries and status reports, with **500 AI credits per user per month**
- All standard integrations

**Enterprise** includes everything in Pro, plus:
- SAML Single Sign-On (Okta, Azure AD, Google)
- SCIM user provisioning
- Audit log
- Advanced permissions and private boards
- Data residency in the EU (Frankfurt) or US (Virginia)
- Unlimited dashboard widgets
- **2,000 AI credits per user per month**
- 99.9% uptime SLA
- A dedicated Customer Success Manager (CSM)

## Integrations

Flowly integrates with: **Slack, Microsoft Teams, Gmail, Outlook, Google Drive, Dropbox, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoom, and Zapier**. Salesforce and Jira integrations are available on **Pro and Enterprise** only. Free accounts can use Slack and Google Drive.

Flowly also offers a **REST API** and webhooks on all plans. API rate limits:
- Free: 60 requests per minute
- Pro: 600 requests per minute
- Enterprise: 3,000 requests per minute

## Free Trial

- New accounts get a **14-day free trial of Pro**, with no credit card required.
- At the end of the trial, the account moves to the Free plan automatically unless a payment method is added. Data is kept, but boards above the Free limit become read-only.
- Enterprise trials of up to **30 days** are available through the Sales team (sales@flowly.io).

## Billing Questions

**Which payment methods do you accept?**
Credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) on all plans. Enterprise customers can also pay by bank transfer against an invoice, with **net 30** payment terms.

**What is the discount for annual billing?**
Annual billing on Pro costs $12 per user/month instead of $15, a **20% discount**.

**Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or education?**
Yes. Registered nonprofits and accredited schools get **50% off Pro**. Apply at flowly.io/nonprofit.

**What happens when I add users mid-cycle?**
New users are billed **pro-rata** for the rest of the billing period. When you remove users, the credit is applied to your next invoice; it is not refunded in cash.

**Can I downgrade?**
Yes. Downgrades take effect at the **end of the current billing period**. Upgrades take effect immediately.

**What happens if a payment fails?**
We retry the card 3 times over 7 days and email the account admins. If payment still fails after **14 days**, the account is suspended (read-only). After **60 days** of suspension, the account moves to the Free plan.

**Can I get a refund?**
See the Customer Support Policy. In short: annual plans can be refunded in full within **30 days** of purchase; monthly plans are not refunded.

**Do you charge VAT?**
Israeli customers are charged 18% VAT. EU business customers with a valid VAT ID are charged under the reverse-charge mechanism.

## Limits and Data

**What happens if I exceed my automation runs?**
Automations pause until the next month. Pro customers can buy an extra **5,000 runs for $20**.

**Where is my data stored?**
By default in AWS US-East (Virginia). Enterprise customers can choose the EU (Frankfurt).

**Can I export my data?**
Yes. Admins on any plan can export all boards to CSV or Excel. Full account export in JSON is available on Pro and Enterprise.

**How long do you keep data after I delete my account?**
Deleted data is kept for **30 days** (recoverable on request) and permanently deleted within **90 days**.

**Is Flowly certified?**
Flowly is SOC 2 Type II certified and ISO 27001 certified, and is GDPR compliant.

## Contact

- Sales: sales@flowly.io
- Support: support@flowly.io, or in-app chat
- Status page: status.flowly.io

# Flowly Security & IT Policy

*Owner: Security team (security@flowly.io). Version 3.0, effective January 1, 2026. Reviewed every year.*

This policy applies to all employees, contractors, and interns of Flowly Ltd. (a fictional company). Flowly holds SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications, and our customers trust us with their data. Every employee must read this policy and complete **security awareness training** in their first week, and again **every year** in January. Violations may lead to disciplinary action, up to termination.

The Security team is led by the **CISO, Roni Golan** (fictional). IT is managed by **Tom Biran, IT Manager** (fictional).

## 1. Passwords

- All passwords must be stored in **1Password**. Storing passwords in browsers, notes, spreadsheets, or Slack is forbidden.
- Passwords must be at least **14 characters** long and unique for each service. Use the 1Password generator.
- The Okta SSO password is changed every **180 days**, or immediately if it may have been exposed.
- Never share passwords, even with IT or managers. IT will **never** ask for your password.
- Shared team credentials (for example, a social media account) must be stored in a shared 1Password vault, never sent in messages.

## 2. Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

- 2FA is **mandatory** on all company accounts, including Okta, Google Workspace, GitHub, AWS, and 1Password.
- Approved methods: **Okta Verify push** or a **YubiKey hardware key**. SMS codes are not allowed.
- R&D employees with production access must use a **YubiKey**. Two keys are provided (main and backup).
- If you lose your phone or YubiKey, report it to IT within **24 hours**.

## 3. Devices

- Only company-managed laptops may access customer data, source code, or production systems.
- All laptops are managed by **Kandji** and must have:
  - Full-disk encryption (FileVault) enabled
  - Automatic screen lock after **5 minutes** of inactivity
  - Operating system updates installed within **14 days** of release (critical updates within **72 hours**)
  - CrowdStrike endpoint protection running
- Personal phones may be used for Slack, email, and Okta Verify only if they have a passcode, are on a supported OS version, and are enrolled in the Kandji BYOD profile.
- Personal laptops and tablets may **not** be used for work.
- Installing unapproved software is not allowed. Request new software in #it-help; the Security team reviews requests within **3 business days**.
- Never leave your laptop unattended in public places. In a car, keep it out of sight in the trunk.
- When working from public places (cafés, airports, hotels), use the **company VPN (Tailscale)**.

## 4. Data Classification and Handling

| Level | Examples | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| **Public** | Website, marketing, public docs | No restrictions |
| **Internal** | Handbook, internal wiki, roadmaps | Share only inside Flowly |
| **Confidential** | Contracts, financials, employee data | Need-to-know access; never share externally without NDA |
| **Restricted** | Customer data, credentials, encryption keys | Strictest controls; access logged; production only |

Rules for customer data:
- Customer data stays in production systems. **Never download customer data** to laptops, or copy it into spreadsheets, Slack, or email.
- Do not paste customer data, source code, or confidential information into public AI tools (for example, public chatbots). Only the company-approved AI tools listed in Notion may be used, with the company account.
- Support agents may access a customer account only with an open Zendesk ticket and the customer's permission ("impersonation consent"). Access is logged.
- Files shared externally from Google Drive must use specific people, not "anyone with the link", and expire after **30 days**.
- Deleting customer data follows the retention rules in the Product FAQ: 30 days recoverable, permanently deleted within 90 days.

## 5. Access Management

- Access follows the **least privilege** principle: you get only what you need for your role.
- Managers review their team's access every **quarter**.
- When an employee leaves, IT removes all access **on the last working day**, by 18:00.
- Production access for new engineers is granted after 2 weeks with approval from the team lead and Security (see the Onboarding Guide).

## 6. Incident Reporting

A security incident is anything that may harm the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of Flowly or customer data. Examples: a phishing email you clicked, a lost laptop or phone, malware, sending data to the wrong person, or suspicious account activity.

**How to report:**
1. Report **immediately, and no later than 1 hour** after you notice it.
2. Post in the **#security-incidents** Slack channel, or email security@flowly.io.
3. Outside working hours, call the Security on-call phone: **+972-3-555-0199** (fictional).
4. Do not try to investigate or fix it yourself, and do not delete evidence.

**Lost or stolen devices** must be reported to IT within **24 hours** (and to the police if stolen). IT will wipe the device remotely.

**Phishing**: forward suspicious emails using the "Report Phishing" button in Gmail. Flowly runs phishing simulations every **quarter**.

After an incident, the Security team classifies its severity within 2 hours. If customer personal data is affected, Flowly notifies affected customers within **72 hours**, in line with GDPR.

No employee will be punished for reporting an incident in good faith, even if they caused it by mistake.

## 7. Acceptable Use

- Company systems are for work. Limited personal use is allowed if it does not affect work or security.
- Do not use company accounts to sign up for services that are not approved.
- Remember the clean desk rule: lock your screen (Cmd+Ctrl+Q) every time you leave your desk.

## 8. Questions

Contact security@flowly.io or ask in #security on Slack.
